svg.aria-label: A sync engine for local-first or offline-first apps. Each device keeps a full local copy of the user's data, so reads and writes happen instantly on the device, even offline. A sync engine sends local changes to the server and pulls other devices' changes in the background. Because every device accepts writes, this is multi-leader replication with each device acting as a leader, and concurrent edits must be merged, for example with CRDTs.
